commands: ls && ls qa tests 2>/dev/null; cat VERSION; head -15 CHANGES.txt; cat rosterkit/models.py 2>/dev/null | head -60; ls rosterkit; cat Makefile
cat rosterkit/errors.py; cat tests/support.py; head -20 tests/test_summary.py; ls tools

python3 - <<'EOF'
p="CHANGES.txt"
t=open(p).read().replace("## Unreleased\n","## Unreleased\n- Added a substitute teacher contact sheet.\n",1)
open(p,"w").write(t)
p="qa/test_contacts.py"
t=open(p).read().replace('"Li, Jo   A','"Li, Jo    A').replace('"Zed, Amy B','"Zed, Amy  B')
open(p,"w").write(t)
EOF
make check 2>&1 | tail -4; make lint | tail -1; awk 'length>72' rosterkit/contacts.py qa/test_contacts.py
git add -A && git commit -q -m "Add substitute teacher contact sheet
